exposure: Model A (all clinics delivered at Royal Aberdeen Children's Hospital)
Model B (all clinics delivered at cluster clinics)
Model C (clinics at both hospital and cluster clinics)
cohort: The study included data for all children in Aberdeen City and Aberdeenshire for whom shortest drivable distance from home to clinic was calculated.
finding: The cluster clinic model (Model B and C) significantly reduces travel distance and simultaneously improves access equality compared to Model A.
